mechanism_narrative: Rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as stronger demand signals robust economic growth and investor confidence.
failure_condition: If GDP growth isn't statistically significant or 20-day forward returns in such periods aren't significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A Fed Funds rate above 5% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as higher interest rates dampen growth expectations.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS doesn't exceed 5% or 20-day returns in such periods are not significantly negative (p>0.05 t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Combined strength in GDP growth (GDPC1) and labor market expansion (PAYEMS) predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns, reflecting improved corporate profits and consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the combination doesn't occur or 60-day returns aren't significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, falling Fed Funds rates (below 4%) signal accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: If the late-cycle expansion regime isn't met or FEDFUNDS <4% doesn't lead to significantly positive 20-day returns (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Easing monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <4.5%) combined with strong production (INDPRO >110) predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: If the combo doesn't occur or 5-day returns aren't significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Improving labor market conditions (falling UNRATE and rising PAYEMS) drive positive 20-day S&P 500 returns by enhancing corporate profits and investor sentiment.
failure_condition: If the combo doesn't occur or 20-day returns aren't significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained rise in the production index (INDPRO) indicates strong supply growth, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as businesses invest and consumers benefit.
failure_condition: If INDPRO doesn't show a sustained upward trend or 60-day returns aren't significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Easing monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <4.5%) paired with robust demand (GDPC1 >16k) predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 returns, signaling expansionary trends.
failure_condition: If the combo doesn't occur or 5-day returns aren't significantly positive (p>0.05).
